def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    counts = np.floor_divide(bins, item)
    remainder = np.mod(bins, item)
    valid = bins >= item
    result = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    # Avoid division by zero when remainder is 0 (perfect fit)
    mask = remainder > 0
    # Use geometric mean: sqrt(counts * (1/remainder)) for non-perfect fits
    result[valid & mask] = np.sqrt(counts[valid & mask] / remainder[valid & mask])
    # For perfect fits (remainder == 0), use counts as priority
    result[valid & ~mask] = counts[valid & ~mask]
    return result

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = np.mod(bins, item)
    can_fit = bins >= item
    needed = np.where(rem == 0, item, item - rem)
    return np.where(can_fit, -needed, -np.inf)
